name: Weekly Late Report
query:
SELECT
    ta.employee_name,
    COUNT(ta.attendance_date) AS late_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ta.attendance_date, '%d %b %Y') SEPARATOR ', ') AS late_dates
FROM
    `tabAttendance` ta
WHERE
    ta.late_entry = 1
    AND ta.docstatus = 1
    AND ta.attendance_date BETWEEN
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY)
        AND
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1 DAY)
GROUP BY
    ta.employee, ta.employee_name
ORDER BY
    ta.employee_name ASC;
